one_line: Human-agent co-filling of high-stakes visa forms with review gates.
what_it_does: Lets an agent read supplied documents, populate a visible visa application field by field, flag uncertainty and discrepancies, explain the form, and run checks while the human retains submission authority.
leverage_rationale: Structured field-level tools and shared visible state materially improve precision, traceability, accessibility, and human review for a high-stakes form; general UI driving is markedly less reliable.
leverage_evidence: ABOUT describes seven imperative document.modelContext tools plus a declarative form tool.
Devpost screenshot visibly shows 19 of 26 fields, 2 flagged, agent-filled labels, and an activity log.
Submission is explicitly excluded from the tool surface.
execution_rationale: The packet coherently shows a populated form, flagged discrepancy, progress tracking, and activity history, but no live video or end-to-end completion evidence limits certainty.
execution_evidence: Devpost packaging screenshot shows personal-details fields populated and a visible review warning.
Frame sheets show a persistent structured form and progress/status panel.
No success or final submission state is shown.
impact_rationale: Visa applicants, people with motor or visual impairments, and applicants working across languages have a concrete high-stakes transcription and comprehension problem; the human-review design addresses it directly.
impact_evidence: ABOUT identifies precise visa transcription burden and accessibility barriers.
Visible evidence includes document-derived values, discrepancy flagging, and progress/activity tracking.
creativity_rationale: The deliberately bounded collaboration—maximum mechanical help with zero automated judgment or submission—is a strong and memorable application of WebMCP to a consequential workflow.
creativity_evidence: Human-agent co-filling with an explicit no-submit boundary.
Agent reads the form back and flags uncertainty rather than silently guessing.
usability_note: Visible progress, activity, flagged fields, and human confirmation support review, though the dense form remains demanding.
red_flags: No submitted video or transcript; visual evidence is packaging/contact-sheet evidence.
Live behavior and full 26-field completion are not demonstrated.
standouts: High-stakes human-in-the-loop boundary.
Accessibility-conscious shared state and discrepancy handling.
advance_reason: Strong problem-solution fit and unusually consequential, well-bounded WebMCP use; packaging evidence is substantial despite absent video.

leverage_rationale: WebMCP is the game’s asymmetric second-player interface: structured diagnostics/manuals/actions are intentionally unavailable to the human or hidden from the agent, so ordinary UI-driving would not reproduce the designed interaction comparably.
leverage_evidence: ABOUT explicitly makes human and agent possess different information and capabilities.
Agent-only diagnostics, manuals, simulations, and actions are core puzzle mechanics.
Packaging screenshot shows POWER FAULT ISOLATION interface.
execution_rationale: Contact sheets show a coherent onboarding-to-generated technical/game workspace and the packaging shows a concrete station interface, but the full four-system mission completion is not visibly proven.
execution_evidence: Frames show repeated onboarding, prompt/session states, and a POWER FAULT ISOLATION artifact.
Devpost screenshot shows the product interface rather than only a concept image.
No final mission-success state is visible.
impact_rationale: There is clear entertainment and experimental value for players interested in cooperative puzzle games, with communication and asymmetric information creating a credible play experience.
impact_evidence: Explicit four-system research-station mission and human/AI roles.
Visible technical puzzle/game workspace.
creativity_rationale: Making the AI a deliberately information-constrained co-player rather than an assistant is a genuinely novel interaction model, pursued through asymmetric puzzle design.

usability_note: The role separation and onboarding appear legible, though the packet does not show the complete playable loop.
red_flags: No submitted video or transcript.
Gameplay completion and live agent invocation are not directly evidenced.
standouts: WebMCP is the interaction design, not a convenience layer.

standouts: Local-first privacy/responsiveness with a single shared command bus.
